plugins.title: Quant run manifest before rerun
plugins.command_or_action: Record the exact rerun command, strategies, Optuna budget, study storage, prediction provider, artifact paths, and excluded work before execution.
plugins.pass_means: The incident contract names the intended run and prevents 'maybe it optimized' ambiguity.

plugins.title: Prediction provider is active
plugins.command_or_action: Assert prediction_provider is present and not none before ROI, alpha, or report output is interpreted.
plugins.pass_means: ML-backed strategies cannot silently fall back to no prediction signal.

plugins.title: No missing predictions for ML-backed strategies
plugins.command_or_action: Prove missing_prediction is zero for ML-backed strategies in the rerun artifact.
plugins.pass_means: The backtest/report did not complete around a dead model signal.

plugins.title: Optuna study and trial count lineage
plugins.command_or_action: Record study storage, study id/name, expected budget, actual trial count, and best trial provenance.
plugins.pass_means: The optimizer ran at the intended scale and the reported best parameters have a study lineage.

plugins.title: Best parameters are consumed by canonical report/backtest
plugins.command_or_action: Prove nested best params are read by the canonical report/backtest path rather than only written as an optimizer artifact.
plugins.pass_means: Default parameters cannot masquerade as optimized parameters in the final report.

plugins.title: Temporal and leakage proof
plugins.command_or_action: Record known-at-time boundaries, walk-forward split, leakage checks, and controls before promoting results.
plugins.pass_means: The incident closeout does not accept a result that may be future-leaking.

plugins.title: Artifact freshness and report lineage
plugins.command_or_action: Record artifact paths, timestamps, report generator input, and the canonical output consumed by the user.
plugins.pass_means: A stale or report-only artifact cannot close the incident.

plugins.title: Report semantic acceptance review
plugins.command_or_action: Review the report against the operator question: identify report family, source lineage, relevant diagnostic rows including blocked/non-actionable evidence, recommendations or stop conditions, and claims not promoted.
plugins.pass_means: A fresh report cannot close the incident unless it is semantically useful for the requested decision.

plugins.title: Connector or backend boundary smoke
plugins.command_or_action: Exercise the real connector/backend boundary or a faithful dry-run and record partial-failure behavior.
plugins.pass_means: The incident did not close on wrapper-only proof while a real boundary remained unexercised.
